verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents automatic receipt-to-card-transaction matching, e-receipts pulled from integrations, or reminders when a receipt is missing. The marketing line that transactions are 'categorized, and automatically compliant' is too generic to count as receipt matching. Document uploads are described only for vendors, customers, invoices and bills, which is AP, not card receipts. The axis clearly applies to an expense product, so absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an employee, receipts match to card transactions automatically — with e-receipts pulled from integrations — and I get nudged only when one is genuinely missing
